note: The agency's switches. Only KT changes mode, budgets and approvals; sessions read this file before every action.

modes_help.drafts-only: Phase 0: plan and render, never schedule or publish.
modes_help.approve-week: Phase 1: schedule a week only after KT's yes is recorded in approvals.
modes_help.autopilot: Phase 2: schedule automatically unless hold is set.
modes_help.hold: Stop: schedule nothing new; leave already-scheduled posts alone and tell KT.
